answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work, fading past the horizon. A fake farm can bloom like an oasis for a moment, but every idle clone's weight thins the instant it stops contributing. The decay is the kernel of the defense: attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever, so a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding bill.
